description.p: A grey liquor, with sickly, yellow flames caressing the surface. When ingested, the target’s eyes and body become wreathed in yellow-green flames for 1 minute. The flames shed dim light in a 10-foot radius, reaching out to drain the life of the target’s enemies. When a large or smaller creature that is hostile to the target moves into the dim light for the first time on a turn, or starts its turn there, they must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they suffer one level of exhaustion.

sheet.description: The target is surrounded by an aura for 1 minute, in which if hostile creatures enter and fail a constitution save they suffer one level of exhaustion.

description.p: A cup of steaming tea. When ingested, it clears the mind, and calms the body. The target adds 1d4 to all Constitution saving throws, Intelligence checks, and Wisdom checks for 1 hour.

sheet.description: The target adds 1d4 to all Constitution saving throw, Intelligence checks, and Wisdom checks for 1 hour. (Can be made with Order Up).

description.p: A sweet and juicy fish. When ingested, it boosts the powers of the mind. The target has advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma checks for 1 minute.

sheet.description: The target gain advantage to all Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma checks for 1 minute.

description.p: Tongue from one of a Hydra’s mouths, simmered in strong aromatics. When ingested, the target grows a second head that lasts for 1 minute. The head grants them the following benefits:

ul.li: Gain 1d10 temporary hits points at the start of their turn.
Any limb amputated in the last 24 hours regenerate at the start of each of their turns.
Gain an extra reaction for only opportunity attacks.
Gain an extra action used only for Disengage, Help, or Search.

description.p: The target grows a second head that vanishes after 1 min, and grants the following benefits:

ul.li: Gain 1d10 temporary hits points at the start of their turn.
Any limb amputated in the last 24 hours regenerate at the start of each of their turns.
Gain an extra reaction for only opportunity attacks.
Gain an extra action used only for Disengage, Help, or Search.

description.p: A delectable fruit sloshing with good juices. When ingested, the juices bolster the body’s constitution. The target gains 1d8 temporary hit points for 1 minute.

The number of temporary hit points gained from this morsel increases by 1d8 when you reach certain levels in this class: 4th level (2d8), 7th level (3d8), 9th level (4d8), 13th level (5d8), 17th level (6d8), and 20th level (7d8).

For 1 minute, if the target drops to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, the target instead drops to 1 hit point, and this morsel’s effect ends.

sheet.description: If the target drops to 0 HP from damage in the next minute, it instead drops to 1 HP and this effect ends.

description.p: Master Brew. A hard, fine liquor. When ingested, the target immediately becomes intoxicated for 10 minutes. When this intoxication ends, the target does not become hung over.

sheet.description: The target is intoxicated for 10 minutes and doesn’t suffer a hang over when it ends.

description.p: The well-seasoned brains of the world’s most capable simians. Within the next 10 minutes, the target can automatically succeed on one saving throw of its choosing. The target can choose to succeed after rolling the saving throw, but before the outcome is determined.

sheet.description: The target can choose to automatically succeed a saving throw within the next 10 minutes.

description.p: A fried chicken leg. When ingested, it feeds the muscles at an enhanced rate. For 1 minute, the target adds 1d4 to all damage rolls and ability checks they make using Strength.
The die rolled for this morsel increases when you reach certain levels in this class: 10th level (1d6), 15th level (1d8), 20th level (1d10).

sheet.description: For 1 min, the target adds 1d4 to all damage rolls and ability checks made with Strength. (Can be made with Order Up).
For 1 min, the target adds 1d6 to all damage rolls and ability checks made with Strength. (Can be made with Order Up).
For 1 min, the target adds 1d8 to all damage rolls and ability checks made with Strength. (Can be made with Order Up).
For 1 min, the target adds 1d10 to all damage rolls and ability checks made with Strength. (Can be made with Order Up).

description.p: Roasted pine nuts smashed into a chunky cream. When ingested, it gives the target a sweet, fragrant breath. All friendly creatures within 10 feet of the target (including the target) have advantage on saving throws for 1 minute.

sheet.description: The target and all allies in a 10 ft range gain advantage to all saving throws for 1 minute.

description.p: A vegetable in the heat of decomposition. When ingested, the target sprays the vegetable’s over-ripened juices all around itself. All hostile creatures within 30 feet of the target (including the target) must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save they are paralyzed until the start of your next turn and blinded for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, a target can make another Constitution saving throw. On a success, they are no longer blinded.

sheet.description: All hostile creatures within 30 ft of the target must make a constitution save, on a fail they are paralyzed until the start of your next turn and blinded for 1 min.

description.p: Roasted pheasant wing. When ingested, it creates a lightness in the body. For 10 minutes, when the target falls, their rate of descent slows to a rate between 5 feet per round and 60 feet per round (their choice). They can choose their rate of descent again at the start of each of their turns. If they land before the morsel’s effect ends, they take no falling damage.

sheet.description: For 10 min, when the target falls, they can choose their rate to be either 5 ft or 60 ft per round for each round they are in the air. If they land before the end of the 10 min, they take no fall damage.

description.p: Leaves of the Shreeve shrub, baked to release calming chemicals. When ingested, the target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes indifferent to all other creatures for 1 minute. The indifference ends early if the target is damaged in any way. A creature who can’t be charmed is immune to this effect.

sheet.description: The target must make a Wisdom save. On fail, the creature becomes indifferent to all other creature for 1 min. The indifference ends early if the target is damaged in any way. A creature who can’t be charmed is immune to this effect.

description.p: A smoky bite of pork. When ingested, it reacts with the stomach’s juices to create a fiery sensation that warms the body and manifests a fever. The target gains resistance to cold damage and immunity to the poisoned condition for 10 minutes.

sheet.description: The target gains resistance to cold damage and immunity to the poisoned condition for 10 mins. (Can be made with Order Up).

description.p: Bean sprouts grown on haunted ground. When ingested, the target gains the benefits of the See Invisibility spell for 1 minute. The target can also use an action to enter or exit the ethereal plane for the duration.

sheet.description: The target gains the benefits of the See Invisibility spell for 1 min. The target can also use an action to enter or exit the ethereal plane.

description.p: A spicy, roasted pepper. When ingested, it causes intense sweating that greases the body. The target gains resistance to fire damage and immunity to the grappled condition for 10 minutes.

sheet.description: The target gains resistance to fire damage and immunity to the grappled condition for 10 mins. (Can be made with Order Up).

description.p: Salt-cured spider eggs. When ingested, it improves the body’s grip. The target gains the effect of the Spider Climb spell for 1 hour.

sheet.description: The target gains the effect of the Spider Climb spell for 1 hour.

description.p: Sunflower seeds baked in starlight. When ingested the target rolls 1d4. The creature can recover expended spell slots that have a combined level that is equal to or less than the number rolled. If the recovered spell slots are not used in the next minute, they are lost.

sheet.description: The target can recover expended spell slots of a combined level up to 1d4. If the recovered spell slots are not used in the next minute, they are lost.

description.p: Brussel sprouts wrapped in ham. When ingested, they power consistent and disruptive flatulence. The target gains immunity to the charmed and frightened conditions for 1 minute.

sheet.description: The target gains immunity to the charmed and frightened conditions for 1 minute.

description.p: Intensely fermented alcohol. When ingested, it loosens the body’s muscles. The target gains resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from weapon attacks for 1 minute.

sheet.description: The target gain resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, slashing and piercing damage for 1 minute.

description.p: A string of crystallized sugars. When ingested, it overcharges the cells. The target’s speed increases by 5 feet for 10 minutes.
This bonus increases when you reach certain levels in this class: 5th level (10 feet), 10th level (15 feet), 15th level (20 feet) and 20th level (25 feet).

sheet.description: The target’s speed increases by 5 ft for 10 min. (Can be made with Order Up).
The target’s speed increases by 15 ft for 10 min. (Can be made with Order Up).
The target’s speed increases by 20 ft for 10 min. (Can be made with Order Up).
The target’s speed increases by 25 ft for 10 min. (Can be made with Order Up).

description.p: Sugared beets dipped in soured creams. When ingested, it softens the skin, weakening the body against physical attacks. For 1 minute, add 1d6 extra damage to the first weapon attack that hits the target on each turn.

sheet.description: For 1 min, add 1d6 extra damage to the first weapon attack that hits the target on each turn.

description.p: A hardy porridge . When ingested, it thickens the skin. The target gains the effect of the Barkskin spell for 10 minutes.

sheet.description: The target gains the effect of the Barkskin spell for 1 hour.

description.p: A pitch black ale, foaming with shadows. When ingested, the target immediately vomits magical darkness that fills a 10- foot radius sphere centered on the target. A creature with darkvision can’t see through this darkness and nonmagical light can’t illuminate it. The darkness lasts for 1 minute. All creatures friendly to the target (including the target) can see through this magical darkness.

sheet.description: The target is surrounded by darkness in a 10 ft range for 1 min.

description.p: A bite of one of your harvests. When prepared, choose one of the benefits listed in your Vital Harvest feature. When this morsel is ingested, the target gains the chosen benefit for 1 minute.

sheet.description: The target gains one effect from Vital Harvest for 1 minute.

description.p: A white swirl of frozen vodka, misting a boozy aroma. When ingested, the target immediately vomits snow that covers the ground around them. The ground in a 15-foot radius centered on the target becomes covered with snow. The snow is considered difficult terrain for all creatures hostile to the target. When the snow is vomited, all creatures hostile to the target within in the area must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is pushed out of the snow’s area, away from the target. The snow lasts for 1 minute, or until melted by an intense heat.

sheet.description: The target is surrounded by difficult terrain in a 15 ft range and hostile creatures in the area must make a Strength save or be knocked back away from the target. This lasts for 1 min.

description.p: Beginning at 7th level, when you make morsels during a long rest, you can make a number of additional morsels equal to your Constitution ability modifier, none of which can have prerequisites.
At 11th level, you can make these additional morsels during a short rest as well as during a long rest.

sheet.description: You can cook an additional {{constitution:modifier}} morsels, which don’t have any prerequisites, every long rest.
You can cook an additional {{constitution:modifier}} morsels, which don’t have any prerequisites, every short or long rest.

description.p: At 5th level, you gain the ability to repel enemies that attack you. Your stomach is of utmost importance, and you have toned your belly to be tough and somewhat gelatinous. When a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to cause the creature to make a Dexterity saving throw against your Morsel save DC. On a failed save, their speed becomes 0 until the end of the turn, and they are either pushed 10 ft away from you or knocked prone (your choice).

sheet.description: When you are attacked by a melee weapon you can use your reaction to make them make a Dexterity Save (DC {{morsel:dc}}) and either be proned or knocked back 10 ft.

description.p: At 1st level, you discover the a mix of spices that create such a visceral and powerful assault on the nose as to break a creature from its stupor. As a bonus action you can wave these spices under the nose of a charmed or frightened creature that you can touch. If the creature has made a saving throw against one of those conditions, they can repeat that saving throw immediately, ending the condition on a success. The creature can only repeat the saving throw for one condition they have per use of this feature, and they cannot repeat a saving throw for the same condition more than once.
At 7th level, the creature can repeat a saving throw against the stunned condition.
At 13th level, the creature can repeat a saving throw against the paralyzed condition.

sheet.description: Allow a creature in melee to repeat a saving throw to break a charmed or frightened condition.
Allow a creature in melee to repeat a saving throw to break a charmed, frightened or stunned condition.
Allow a creature in melee to repeat a saving throw to break a charmed, frightened, stunned or paralyzed condition.

description.p: At 15th level, you have attuned your body’s life force to the nourishing energies of the world. You can cast Create Food and Water once with this feature and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you do so, the food you create is not bland, but flavorful and enjoyable. Also, the food you create does not spoil for 1 week.
In addition, if you make morsels, and you have no ingredients left, you conjure the necessary ingredients as part of making the morsels.

sheet.description: You can cast Create Food and Water and you don’t need ingredients to make morsels.

description.p: You can cast heroism once using a warlock spell slot. You can’t do so again until you finish a long rest.

sheet.description: You can cast heroism once using a warlock spell slot.

description.p: You can cast animal messenger at will as a 3rd-level spell.

sheet.description: You can cast animal messenger at will as a 3rd-level spell.

description.p: When you roll an ability check, you can add double your proficiency bonus to the check even if you aren’t normally proficient. If you fail, you can’t use this invocation again until you finish a short or long rest. If you succeed, you gain one level of exhaustion and can’t use this ability again until you finish a long rest.
This level of exhaustion can’t be fatal and this feature can’t be used for ability checks regarding longterm attempts, such as for downtime activities.

sheet.description: When you roll an ability check, you can add double your proficiency bonus to the check even if you aren’t normally proficient. If you fail, you can’t use this invocation again until you finish a short rest. If you succeed, you gain one level of exhaustion and can’t use this ability again until you finish a long rest. This level of exhaustion can’t be fatal and this feature can’t be used for ability checks regarding longterm attempts, such as for downtime activities.

description.p: You can cast web once using a warlock spell slot. You can’t do so again until you finish a long rest. In addition, you are immune to movement restrictions caused by webbing.

sheet.description: You can cast web once using a warlock spell slot. In addition, you are immune to movement restrictions caused by webbing.

description.p: Targets of your infestation cantrip take damage whether they succeed or fail on their saving throw against the spell. In addition, targets who fail their saving throw move in a direction you dictate instead of moving randomly. You cannot force a creature to move into an obvious hazard, such as into fire or off of a cliff. If you do not designate a direction, the target moves randomly as normal.

sheet.description: Targets of your infestation cantrip take damage whether they succeed or fail on their saving throw against the spell. In addition, targets who fail their saving throw move in a direction you dictate instead of moving randomly. You cannot force a creature to move into an obvious hazard, such as into fire or off of a cliff. If you do not designate a direction, the target moves randomly as normal.

description.p: You can cast catnap once without using a spell slot. When you do so, you can target a number of willing creatures as if you had cast the spell using a warlock spell slot, and you can include yourself without counting against the number of targets. If you do, you remain aware of your surroundings using your passive Perception score and can end the spell on yourself early at will; you are otherwise treated as unconscious.

sheet.description: You can cast catnap once without using a spell slot. When you do so, you can target a number of willing creatures as if you had cast the spell using a warlock spell slot, and you can include yourself without counting against the number of targets. If you do, you remain aware of your surroundings using your passive Perception score and can end the spell on yourself early at will; you are otherwise treated as unconscious.

p.em: Prerequisite: Pact of the Tome feature

description.p: Choose three languages from among Abyssal, Celestial, Deep Speech, Draconic, Infernal, Primordial, and Sylvan. You are able to speak, read, and understand the chosen languages while you are holding your Book of Shadows.

sheet.description: You are able to speak, read, and understand the chosen languages while you are holding your Book of Shadows.

p.em: Prerequisite: Pact of the Blade feature

description.p: When a hostile creature that you can see within 5 feet of you would hit you with a melee weapon attack, you can use your reaction to increase your AC against the attack by an amount equal to your Charisma modifier. If the attack misses as a result, the target takes psychic damage equal to your warlock level; if it still hits, the attacker takes psychic damage equal to half your warlock level.
Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.

sheet.description: When a hostile creature that you can see within 5 feet of you would hit you with a melee weapon attack, you can increase your AC against the attack by {{charisma:modifier}}. If the attack misses as a result, the target takes {{level:warlock}} psychic damage; if it still hits, the attacker takes {{level:warlock:half}} psychic damage.

description.p: When a creature within 30 feet of you damages you with an attack, you can cast true strike against it as a reaction. If the attack empowered by true strike hits the target, the target takes additional psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier.

sheet.description: When a creature within 30 feet of you damages you with an attack, you can cast true strike against it. If the attack empowered by true strike hits the target, the target takes {{charisma:modifier}} additional psychic damage.

description.p: Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Acrobatics check you make.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Animal Handling check you make.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Arcana check you make.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Athletics check you make.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Deception check you make.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any History check you make.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Insight check you make.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Intimidation check you make.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Investigation check you make.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Medicine check you make.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Nature check you make.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Perception check you make.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Performance check you make.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Persuasion check you make.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Religion check you make.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Sleight of Hand check you make.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Stealth check you make.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Survival check you make.
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Thieves’ Tools check you make.

sheet.description: Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Thieves’ Tools check you make.

description.p: When you are hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to unleash a burst of sound. If the attacker is within 10 feet of you and can hear, they suffer disadvantage on their next attack against you before the start of their next turn.

sheet.description: When you are hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to unleash a burst of sound. If the attacker is within 10 feet of you and can hear, they suffer disadvantage on their next attack against you before the start of their next turn.

description.p: When you take the Attack action on your turn and make an attack with your ringing weapon, you can choose to hone the disruptive sound. If this attack hits a creature that is concentrating on a spell, it has disadvantage on the saving throw to maintain concentration.

sheet.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn and make an attack with your ringing weapon, you can choose to hone the disruptive sound. If this attack hits a creature that is concentrating on a spell, it has disadvantage on the saving throw to maintain concentration.

p.em: Prerequisite: Weaver of Lies patron, Pact of the Tome feature

description.p: Whenever you finish a short or long rest, you can perform a weaving ritual over the course of 10 minutes. When you finish, you can touch a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier. These creatures are immune to the web spell or natural webbing and climbing costs no extra movement while the creature is touching a web. This lasts until that creature finishes a short or long rest.

sheet.description: Whenever you finish a short or long rest, you can perform a weaving ritual over the course of 10 minutes. When you finish, you can touch {{charisma:modifier}} creatures. These creatures are immune to the web spell or natural webbing and climbing costs no extra movement while the creature is touching a web. This lasts until that creature finishes a short or long rest.

description.p: You can cast greater restoration using a warlock spell slot. Once you cast this spell, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.

sheet.description: You can cast greater restoration using a warlock spell slot.

description.p: Whenever you use your Righteous Guardian feature on an ally who has at least 1 hit point, they regain hit points equal to your Charisma modifier.

sheet.description: Whenever you use your Righteous Guardian feature on an ally who has at least 1 hit point, they regain {{charisma:modifier}} hit points.

description.p: Whenever you cast a spell with the word “smite” in the name, you can choose to have it function with any weapon attack, rather than only melee weapon attacks.

sheet.description: Whenever you cast a spell with the word “smite” in the name, you can choose to have it function with any weapon attack, rather than only melee weapon attacks.

description.p: When you cast a cantrip that deals damage or make a weapon attack, you can use a bonus action to cast lightning bolt using a warlock spell slot at a target of your cantrip or weapon attack.

sheet.description: When you cast a cantrip that deals damage or make a weapon attack, you can cast lightning bolt using a warlock spell slot at a target of your cantrip or weapon attack.

p.em: Prerequisite: Weaver of Lies patron, pact of the chain feature

description.p: If you have a shade widow as your familiar, it gains additional hit points equal to your warlock level. Whenever it uses the Bite action, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the target's first Constitution saving throw.

sheet.description: If you have a shade widow as your familiar, whenever it uses the Bite action, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the target's first Constitution saving throw.

p.em: Prerequisite: Fallen Exile patron, Pact of the Tome feature

description.p: When a creature targets you with an attack, you can use your reaction to unleash a wave of sparkling light around yourself in a 10-foot radius. All invisible creatures and objects in the area are highlighted by glowing motes of stardust. Hostile creatures in the area must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your warlock spell save DC or become blinded until the start of your next turn. Once you use this ability, you cannot do so again until you finish a short or long rest. Additionally, you can’t become lost when you have an unobstructed view of the night sky, and you gain advantage on ability checks made to navigate at night.

sheet.description: When a creature targets you with an attack, you can unleash a wave of sparkling light around yourself in a 10-foot radius. All invisible creatures and objects in the area are highlighted by glowing motes of stardust. Hostile creatures in the area must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC {{spellcasting:dc:cha}}) or become blinded until the start of your next turn. Additionally, you can’t become lost when you have an unobstructed view of the night sky, and you gain advantage on ability checks made to navigate at night.

p.em: Prerequisite: Blackthorn Grove patron. Pact of the Blade

description.p: You can choose to create a weapon from polished black wood and wicked spines using your Pact of the Blade feature. While you maintain concentration on a spell cast using a warlock spell slot while wielding this weapon, dense foliage covers your skin, causing your AC to equal 17 if it would normally be lower.

sheet.description: While you maintain concentration on a spell cast using a warlock spell slot while wielding your Pact of the Blade weapon, dense foliage covers your skin, causing your AC to equal 17 if it would normally be lower.

description.p: Whenever you cast a spell using a warlock spell slot, you gain advantage on the first ability check you make before the end of your next turn.

sheet.description: Whenever you cast a spell using a warlock spell slot, you gain advantage on the first ability check you make before the end of your next turn.

p.em: Prerequisite: Keeper of the Depths patron

description.p: Whenever you finish a long rest, your mind overflows with the terrible secrets of your patron. You can speak to one allied creature over the course of 10 minutes, filling its mind with what you’ve learned. That creature can add your proficiency bonus to one skill or tool of your choice that it is not already proficient in until its next long rest.

sheet.description: You can speak to one allied creature over the course of 10 minutes, filling its mind with what you’ve learned. That creature can add your proficiency bonus to one skill or tool of your choice that it is not already proficient in until its next long rest.

description.p: Whenever you make a Wisdom saving throw and succeed, your mind locks shut. If the same creature or effect forces you to make another Wisdom saving throw before the end of your next turn, that saving throw is made with advantage.

sheet.description: Whenever you make a Wisdom saving throw and succeed, your mind locks shut. If the same creature or effect forces you to make another Wisdom saving throw before the end of your next turn, that saving throw is made with advantage.

description.p: You can cast plane shift without expending a spell slot. Once you cast this spell in this way, you can’t do so again until you finish a long rest.

sheet.description: You can cast plane shift without expending a spell slot.

p.em: Prerequisite: Weaver of Lies patron, eldritch blast cantrip

description.p: Whenever you cast eldritch blast, you can use a bonus action to send transparent webbing to bind all targets that you've hit with your eldritch blast. All targets must make a Wisdom saving throw against your warlock spell save DC. Those that fail cannot move farther away from others that have also failed until the beginning of your next turn, as ethereal webbing ties them together.

sheet.description: Whenever you cast eldritch blast, you can send transparent webbing to bind all targets that you've hit with your eldritch blast. All targets must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC {{spellcasting:dc:cha}}). Those that fail cannot move farther away from others that have also failed until the beginning of your next turn, as ethereal webbing ties them together.

description.p: Your Black Ice feature can trigger when you cast a cantrip that requires a saving throw. When you use your Black Ice feature, you can choose to have that cantrip or attack deal cold damage instead of its normal damage type. If the target takes damage from the attack or cantrip, it can’t benefit from features or effects that allow it to ignore difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.

sheet.description: Your Black Ice feature can trigger when you cast a cantrip that requires a saving throw. When you use your Black Ice feature, you can choose to have that cantrip or attack deal cold damage instead of its normal damage type. If the target takes damage from the attack or cantrip, it can’t benefit from features or effects that allow it to ignore difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.

p.em: Prerequisite: Pact of the Blade feature

description.p: As a bonus action, you can empower your pact weapon with eldritch energy. The first time you hit a creature with an empowered pact weapon before the start of your next turn, it takes additional force damage equal to half your warlock level and if the attack was a critical hit, the target is knocked prone.

sheet.description: The first time you hit a creature with an empowered pact weapon before the start of your next turn, it takes {{level:warlock:half}} additional force damage and if the attack was a critical hit, the target is knocked prone.

p.em: Prerequisite: Weaver of Lies patron, level 7

description.p: You can activate the Poisoned Mind feature whenever you cast a cantrip that targets only one enemy creature.

sheet.description: You can activate the Poisoned Mind feature whenever you cast a cantrip that targets only one enemy creature.

p.em: Prerequisite: Keeper of the Depths patron, Pact of the Tome

description.p: Whenever you are in conversation, you can take your Book of Shadows in hand and ask a creature one question. The creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your warlock spell save DC if it is unwilling to answer. If it fails or if it decides to respond truthfully, the most accurate answer the creature could possibly give is immediately written in the book. Once you do this, you can’t do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

sheet.description: Whenever you are in conversation, you can take your Book of Shadows in hand and ask a creature one question. The creature must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC {{spellcasting:dc:cha}}) if it is unwilling to answer. If it fails or if it decides to respond truthfully, the most accurate answer the creature could possibly give is immediately written in the book.

p.em: Prerequisite: Blackthorn Grove patron, Pact of the Tome feature

description.p: During a short or long rest, you can choose to create an effigy from plant material, weaving and shaping it into a heart. Over the course of one minute, you can choose to replace the heart of a dead creature with this effigy, causing it to rise as a zombie with 1 hit point. The zombie will unerringly seek a path towards a destination you name at the time of this ritual. It will ignore any creatures it encounters and will not pause or stop unless it is destroyed. Once the zombie reaches its destination, it will fall to the ground and a sapling will sprout from the corpse. If you create a new effigy, the previous one ceases to function, and the zombie crumbles to the ground, a lifeless corpse once more.

sheet.description: During a short or long rest, you can choose to create an effigy from plant material, weaving and shaping it into a heart. Over the course of one minute, you can choose to replace the heart of a dead creature with this effigy, causing it to rise as a zombie with 1 hit point. The zombie will unerringly seek a path towards a destination you name at the time of this ritual. It will ignore any creatures it encounters and will not pause or stop unless it is destroyed. Once the zombie reaches its destination, it will fall to the ground and a sapling will sprout from the corpse. If you create a new effigy, the previous one ceases to function, and the zombie crumbles to the ground, a lifeless corpse once more.

description.p: Once during a rest, you can cast dream without expending a spell slot. Casting this spell does not interfere with your rest.

sheet.description: You can cast dream without expending a spell slot. Casting this spell does not interfere with your rest.

p.em: Prerequisite: Currency Conspiracy patron, Pact of the Blade

description.p: You can choose to create a weapon from pure golden metal covered in precious gemstones using your Pact of the Blade feature. While you are wielding this weapon, you can choose to make an exchanging strike in place of a weapon attack. Make a Charisma (Persuasion) check contested by the target’s Wisdom (Insight) check. If you succeed, you trade the pact weapon in your hand for one object the target is currently holding, passing your blade to them and taking the item in one smooth motion. Creatures that are immune to the charmed condition are immune to this feature.

sheet.description: While you are wielding your Pact of the Blade weapon, you can choose to make an exchanging strike in place of a weapon attack. Make a Charisma (Persuasion) check contested by the target’s Wisdom (Insight) check. If you succeed, you trade the pact weapon in your hand for one object the target is currently holding, passing your blade to them and taking the item in one smooth motion. Creatures that are immune to the charmed condition are immune to this feature.

p.em: Prerequisite: Accursed Archive patron, Pact of the Blade

description.p: Using your Pact of the Blade feature, you can create a weapon wrapped in raven feathers and the hide of abominations that drips and bleeds black ink. When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can cast a single 1st level spell you know with a casting time of one bonus action without expending a spell slot. Once you cast a spell in this way, you can’t do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

sheet.description: When you hit a creature using a weapon from your Pact of the Blade feature, you can cast a single 1st level spell you know with a casting time of one bonus action without expending a spell slot.

description.p: You gain advantage on attack rolls targeting creatures that you have charmed. If you attack a creature you have charmed, it can’t take reactions until the end of your next turn.

sheet.description: You gain advantage on attack rolls targeting creatures that you have charmed. If you attack a creature you have charmed, it can’t take reactions until the end of your next turn.

p.em: Prerequisite: Gelatinous Convocation patron, Pact of the Tome feature

description.p: Whenever you use your Recovered Memories feature to absorb the knowledge of a creature, you can store the experience in your Book of Shadows, and make it come to life upon the pages of the book. You can copy and transfer any memories within your Book to another creature by touching them with the Book as an action.

sheet.description: Whenever you use your Recovered Memories feature to absorb the knowledge of a creature, you can store the experience in your Book of Shadows, and make it come to life upon the pages of the book. You can copy and transfer any memories within your Book to another creature by touching them with the Book as an action.

description.p: Whenever you cast a cantrip that deals damage or make a weapon attack, you can use a bonus action to infuse it with acidic energy. The cantrip or attack deals acid damage instead of the normal type, can target objects, and inflicts twice as much damage to unattended objects and structures. If a creature damaged by this acid is using a nonmagical shield, they must make a Dexterity saving throw against your warlock spell save DC. If they fail, their shield is destroyed.

sheet.description: Whenever you cast a cantrip that deals damage or make a weapon attack, you can infuse it with acidic energy. The cantrip or attack deals acid damage instead of the normal type, can target objects, and inflicts twice as much damage to unattended objects and structures. If a creature damaged by this acid is using a nonmagical shield, they must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC {{spellcasting:dc:cha}}). If they fail, their shield is destroyed.

p.em: Prerequisite: Perfect Chord patron, Pact of the Chain feature

description.p: If you have a symphonic songbird as your familiar, it gains additional maximum hit points equal to your warlock level. You can choose to cast spells that require only verbal components as though you were in your familiar’s space.

sheet.description: If you have a symphonic songbird as your familiar, you can choose to cast spells that require only verbal components as though you were in your familiar’s space.

p.em: Ashen Wolf patron, Pact of the Tome feature

description.p: You can perform a ritual for the Wolf during a short or long rest. When you do so, choose either Dexterity or Strength saving throws. When you make a saving throw of this type, you can use your reaction to gain advantage on that saving throw and cast a cantrip with a casting time of one action. Once you use this invocation, you cannot do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

sheet.description: During a short or long rest choose either Dexterity or Strength saving throws. When you make a saving throw of this type, you can gain advantage on that saving throw and cast a cantrip with a casting time of one action.

p.em: Prerequisite: Keeper of the Depths patron

description.p: Whenever you deal damage to an enemy creature with a cantrip or weapon attack, you can use your bonus action to disrupt their magic. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw against your warlock spell save DC. If they fail, their concentration saving throws are made with disadvantage until the end of your next turn and if the target is not maintaining concentration on a spell, it takes 1d4 psychic damage.

sheet.description: Whenever you deal damage to an enemy creature with a cantrip or weapon attack, you can disrupt their magic. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC {{spellcasting:dc:cha}}). If they fail, their concentration saving throws are made with disadvantage until the end of your next turn and if the target is not maintaining concentration on a spell, it takes 1d4 psychic damage.

p.em: Prerequisite: Shadowcat patron, Pact of the Tome feature

description.p: You can summon forth nightmarish fire from the Inverse to deepen the darkness of an area. By performing a 10-minute ritual, you can create a cold, black shadowflame around an object you are touching. The object consumes light within a 30-foot radius, turning bright light to dim light and dim light to nonmagical darkness. A shadowflame remains until you dispel it as an action, it enters the radius of another shadowflame, or it comes into contact with real fire.

sheet.description: You can summon forth nightmarish fire from the Inverse to deepen the darkness of an area. The object consumes light within a 30-foot radius, turning bright light to dim light and dim light to nonmagical darkness. A shadowflame remains until you dispel it as an action, it enters the radius of another shadowflame, or it comes into contact with real fire.

description.p: You can cast polymorph once without expending a spell slot, but only to turn the target into a snake or other reptile. Once you do this, you can’t do so again until you finish a long rest.

sheet.description: You can cast polymorph once without expending a spell slot, but only to turn the target into a snake or other reptile.

description.p: Whenever you cast a spell with a range of Self using a warlock spell slot, choose one creature within 15 feet of you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw against your warlock spell save DC. If they fail, they are charmed by you until the end of your next turn.

sheet.description: Whenever you cast a spell with a range of Self using a warlock spell slot, choose one creature within 15 feet of you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC {{spellcasting:dc:cha}}). If they fail, they are charmed by you until the end of your next turn.

p.em: Prerequisite: Pact of the Tome feature

description.p: You are aware of the presence of any Alrisen upon the same plane as you, and you have learned the relationships that they may have with one another. You are instantly aware if any of these relationships change. If you are loyal to one or more of them, you know what direction they are in, like a compass. Most Alrisen have the capacity to conceal themselves from your detection at their discretion. You also gain advantage on checks made to identify their followers, servants, slaves, or other minions.

sheet.description: You are aware of the presence of any Alrisen upon the same plane as you, and you have learned the relationships that they may have with one another. You are instantly aware if any of these relationships change. If you are loyal to one or more of them, you know what direction they are in, like a compass. Most Alrisen have the capacity to conceal themselves from your detection at their discretion. You also gain advantage on checks made to identify their followers, servants, slaves, or other minions.

p.em: Prerequisite: Perfect Chord patron, Pact of the Tome feature

description.p: You can ignore the effects of the silence spell and of magical effects that would produce a similar area of magical silence, enabling you to speak and cast spells normally. You also become immune to the deafened condition.

sheet.description: You can ignore the effects of the silence spell and of magical effects that would produce a similar area of magical silence, enabling you to speak and cast spells normally. You also become immune to the deafened condition.

p.em: Prerequisite: Currency Conspiracy patron, Pact of the Tome feature

description.p: During a short or long rest, you can summon a contract detailing any agreement filled with your exact stipulations and requests. Any creature that signs the contract is bound by an obligation to fulfill the terms of the agreement for as long as the contract exists or until the terms are completed. If you break the agreement, you lose Gilt equal to three times your character level. If the amount lost is higher than your current total, you suffer force damage equal to twice the difference. If a creature other than you breaks the agreement, you can choose to spend an amount of Gilt equal to or less than five times your warlock level, dealing force damage equal to the amount spent to all offending parties. Once you either break the contract or inflict damage using this feature, the contract is destroyed and can no longer be enforced. You can have a maximum number of contracts in existence at one time equal to your Charisma modifier.

sheet.description: During a short or long rest, you can summon a contract detailing any agreement filled with your exact stipulations and requests. Any creature that signs the contract is bound by an obligation to fulfill the terms of the agreement for as long as the contract exists or until the terms are completed. Once you either break the contract or inflict damage using this feature, the contract is destroyed and can no longer be enforced. You can have a maximum of {{charisma:modifier}} contracts in existence at one time.

p.em: Prerequisite: Gelatinous Convocation patron, Pact of the Chain

description.p: While you have a wiggly cube as your familiar, it gains additional maximum hit points equal to your warlock level. When you reach 6th level, you can choose to have your wiggly cube grow to become a Medium creature, and at 14th level, you can choose to have your wiggly cube become a Large creature. You can change the size of the cube as a bonus action. Whenever it is Medium, it’s Engulf damage improves to 2d8 initial damage and to 4d8 at the start of the cube’s turn. When it is Large, the damage improves to 3d8 initial damage and to 5d8 at the start of the cube’s turn.

sheet.description: If you have a wiggly cube as your familiar it can grow to medium size as a bonus action. When its size is medium its engulf damage is 2d8 initial damage and 4d8 at the start of the cube's turn.

If you have a wiggly cube as your familiar it can grow to medium size as a bonus action. When its size is medium its engulf damage is 2d8 initial damage and 4d8 at the start of the cube's turn. It can also grow to large size increasing engulf damage to 3d8 initial damage and 5d8 at the start of the cube's turn.

p.em: Prerequisite: Forbidden Graveyard patron, Pact of the Tome feature

description.p: If you have a haunted crow as your familiar, it gains additional hit points equal to your warlock level. While you have this familiar, it recovers a single use of its Shriek action whenever either of you reduces a creature to 0 hit points, and the saving throw DC of this action equals your warlock spell save DC.

sheet.description: If you have a haunted crow as your familiar, it recovers a single use of its Shriek action whenever either of you reduces a creature to 0 hit points, and the saving throw DC of this action is {{spellcasting:dc:cha}}.

description.p: When you cast a spell that creates an illusion, you can use your bonus action to become invisible until the start of your next turn, leaving an illusion of yourself standing in your place. You can do this a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier, and these uses recover when you finish a long rest.

sheet.description: When you cast a spell that creates an illusion, you can become invisible until the start of your next turn, leaving an illusion of yourself standing in your place.

description.p: Your flesh grows corrupt in appearance but is imbued with terrible might. While you are not wearing armor or using a shield, you can choose to have your AC equal 10 + your Strength modifier + your Charisma modifier.

sheet.description: While you are not wearing armor or using a shield, you can choose to have your AC equal {{ac:curse of carasphyx}}.

description.p: You can cast fly on yourself at will without expending a spell slot or material components.

sheet.description: You can cast fly on yourself at will without expending a spell slot or material components.

description.p: Whenever you choose your proficiencies for your Secrets of the Lost feature, you can forfeit both gained proficiencies. When you do, you can have your proficiency bonus be doubled for any ability check on a single skill or tool you are proficient with. This lasts until you finish a long rest.

sheet.description: Whenever you choose your proficiencies for your Secrets of the Lost feature, you can forfeit both gained proficiencies. description.p: As an action, you can create a 5-foot cube of magical darkness at a point that you can see within 60 feet of you by speaking a phrase from a forgotten tongue. The cube lasts until the start of your next turn unless you use your action to sustain it.

sheet.description: You can create a 5-foot cube of magical darkness at a point that you can see within 60 feet of you by speaking a phrase from a forgotten tongue. The cube lasts until the start of your next turn unless you use your action to sustain it.

description.p: If you have an eyeless watcher as a familiar, it gains additional hit points equal to your warlock level. Whenever your eyeless watcher takes the Help action, it can use a bonus action to become invisible until the start of its next turn.

sheet.description: If you have an eyeless watcher as a familiar, it gains {{level:warlock}} additional hit points. Whenever your eyeless watcher takes the Help action, it can use a bonus action to become invisible until the start of its next turn.

sheet.description: When you kill a creature with your pact weapon, you siphon a fragment of their essence. The next time you hit with your pact weapon, you deal {{level:warlock}} extra force damage.

description.p: Whenever you cast a spell using a warlock spell slot, you can use your bonus action to collect the excess power. The next time you cast eldritch blast, you can choose one of the following options to replace the normal beams of energy with shaped explosions. The DC of any saving throw is equal to your warlock spell save DC.

ul.li: Pulse: You unleash a pulse of eldritch energy in a 10-foot radius around you. Target a number of creatures that you can see in the area equal to your number of eldritch blast beams. Each creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be struck by one beam.

Shockwave: You unleash a wave of eldritch energy in a 20- foot cone. Target a number of creatures that you can see in the area equal to your number of eldritch blast beams. Each creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be struck by one beam.

The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be struck by all beams of your eldritch blast. If this attack kills the creature, you can use your bonus action to prepare another Eldritch Shape.

Destruction: You unleash an web of chaotic eldritch energy. Target one creature you can see within range, and then target up to 4 other enemy creatures you can see within 30 feet of the primary target. Each secondary target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be struck by one beam of your eldritch blast. The primary target is struck by a number of beams of your eldritch blast equal to the number of creatures who failed their saving throw.

description.p: If all of your warlock spell slots have been expended, you can use your bonus action to spend Gilt equal to four times your warlock level to regain one warlock spell slot. Once you use this invocation, you can’t do so again until you finish a long rest.

sheet.description: If all of your warlock spell slots have been expended, you can spend {{emergency fund:gilt sacrifice}} Gilt to regain one warlock spell slot.

p.em: Prerequisite: Ashen Wolf patron, Pact of the Chain feature

description.p: If you have an emberborn as your familiar, it gains additional hit points equal to your warlock level plus twice your Charisma modifier. When you reach 11th level, the emberborn can grow in size to become a Medium creature, at your discretion. While it is Medium, its bite attack deals 2d6 piercing damage and 2d6 fire damage, and the emberborn’s speed increases to 50 feet. Creatures hit by the bite attack must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. At 16th level, the Medium emberborn’s bite attack deals 3d6 piercing damage and 3d6 fire damage, and the Strength saving throw DC equals your warlock spell save DC.

sheet.description: If you have an emberborn as your familiar it can grow to medium size at your discretion, when it is medium sized its bite attack deals 2d6 piercing damage and 2d6 fire damage, and its speed increases to 50 ft. Creatures hit by the bite attack must succeed a Strength saving throw (DC 13) or be knocked prone.

If you have an emberborn as your familiar it can grow to medium size at your discretion, when it is medium sized its bite attack deals 3d6 piercing damage and 3d6 fire damage, and its speed increases to 50 ft. Creatures hit by the bite attack must succeed a Strength saving throw (DC{{spellcasting:dc:cha}}) or be knocked prone.

p.em: Prerequisite: Storm Lord patron, Pact of the Chain feature

description.p: If you have a spark seeker as your familiar, it gains additional hit points equal to your warlock level. While you have a spark seeker as your familiar, you can cast spells that deal lightning or thunder damage as though your familiar was the point of origin for the spell when determining the range and available targets.

sheet.description: While you have a spark seeker as your familiar, you can cast spells that deal lightning or thunder damage as though your familiar was the point of origin for the spell when determining the range and available targets.

description.p: Your Stolen Luck curse draws your patron’s eye. The target’s d20 roll is changed to a 1 if the result of your d6 roll is a 5 or 6.

sheet.description: The target of your Stolen Luck feature's d20 roll is changed to a 1 if the result of your d6 roll is a 5 or 6.

description.p: As an action, you imbue your eyes with eldritch magic and glare darkly at a creature. If the target can see you, it suffers disadvantage on its next attack roll or ability check made within 1 minute.

sheet.description: You imbue your eyes with eldritch magic and glare darkly at a creature. If the target can see you, it suffers disadvantage on its next attack roll or ability check made within 1 minute.

description.p: As an action, you can choose to perceive through the senses of an undead creature within 120 feet of you until the start of your next turn. During this time, you are deaf and blind with regard to your own senses.

sheet.description: You can choose to perceive through the senses of an undead creature within 120 feet of you until the start of your next turn. During this time, you are deaf and blind with regard to your own senses.

p.em: Prerequisite: Shadowcat patron, Pact of the Blade

description.p: When you create a melee weapon with the finesse property using your Pact of the Blade feature, you can make it from polished silver flowing with blue-black smoke. While wielding this weapon, you gain advantage on initiative rolls. During the first round of combat, attacks with this weapon deal extra psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier plus half your warlock level.

sheet.description: When you create a melee weapon with the finesse property using your Pact of the Blade feature and wielding this weapon, you gain advantage on initiative rolls. During the first round of combat, attacks with this weapon deal an extra {{fang of the prowler:damage}} psychic damage.

p.em: Prerequisite: Storm Lord patron, Pact of the Blade

description.p: When you create a weapon with your Pact of the Blade feature, you can infuse it with silver mist and form it from stormscarred steel. When you attack with this weapon, you can use your Charisma modifier, instead of Strength or Dexterity, for the attack and damage rolls. When a ranged attack misses you while you are wielding this weapon, you can use your reaction to move up to 15 feet without provoking opportunity attacks, and you can move through spaces occupied by hostile creatures without spending additional movement.

sheet.description: When you attack with a weapon from your Pact of the Blade feature, you can use your Charisma modifier, instead of Strength or Dexterity, for the attack and damage rolls. When a ranged attack misses you while you are wielding this weapon, you can use your reaction to move up to 15 feet without provoking opportunity attacks, and you can move through spaces occupied by hostile creatures without spending additional movement.

p.em: Prerequisite: Pact of the Tome feature

description.p: Your Book of Shadows is no longer destroyed when you die, and it can be used in place of your corpse to restore you to life.

sheet.description: Your Book of Shadows is no longer destroyed when you die, and it can be used in place of your corpse to restore you to life.

p.em: Prerequisite: The Gray Portrait patron, level 11

description.p: While you are within an art demiplane, you can use your bonus action to teleport to any location within the demiplane that you can see. You can also use your action to create an art demiplane in a different piece of real art you can see and teleport to a location within that demiplane. The new piece of real art must be within 60 feet of the original piece.

sheet.description: While you are within an art demiplane, you can use your bonus action to teleport to any location within the demiplane that you can see. You can also use your action to create an art demiplane in a different piece of real art you can see and teleport to a location within that demiplane. The new piece of real art must be within 60 feet of the original piece.

p.em: Prerequisite: 15th level, Pact of the Blade feature

description.p: When you summon your pact weapon, you can use your bonus action to cast a spell of 1st level or higher with a casting time of 1 action. If you do, you gain advantage on the next attack made with your pact weapon.

sheet.description: When you summon your pact weapon, you can use your bonus action to cast a spell of 1st level or higher with a casting time of 1 action. If you do, you gain advantage on the next attack made with your pact weapon.

p.em: Prerequisite: 15th level, Pact of the Tome feature

description.p: Whenever you cast a cantrip, you can use your bonus action to bolster yourself with a defensive aura of swirling eldritch energy. Until the start of your next turn, when a hostile creature enters a space within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to detonate the aura to push the enemy up to 10 feet directly away from you.

sheet.description: Whenever you cast a cantrip, you can use your bonus action to bolster yourself with a defensive aura of swirling eldritch energy. Until the start of your next turn, when a hostile creature enters a space within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to detonate the aura to push the enemy up to 10 feet directly away from you.

description.p: Your control over your familiar increases. When you finish a short or long rest, you can cast find familiar as an action without expending a spell slot or using material components.

p.em: Prerequisite: Storm Lord patron, Pact of the Tome feature

description.p: Whenever you finish a long rest, you can perform a percussive ritual over the course of 10 minutes to change the weather. When you finish, an unnatural storm with a 1-mile radius rolls in and follows you, gently raining and occasionally flashing with lightning. When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points while outside, you can use your reaction to call down a bolt of lightning to strike the downed creature. You gain resistance to lightning and thunder damage for 1 minute, and each creature that you choose within a 10-foot radius of the strike must make a Constitution saving throw against your warlock spell save DC. If they fail, they take thunder damage equal to your warlock level and are deafened for 1 minute. Once you summon lightning this way, you can’t do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

sheet.description: Whenever you finish a long rest, you can perform a percussive ritual over the course of 10 minutes to change the weather. description.p: While asleep, you gain resistance to all damage, and you automatically awaken when a hostile creature is within 15 feet of you. If you awaken in this way, you gain advantage on your first initiative roll within 1 minute.

sheet.description: While asleep, you gain resistance to all damage, and you automatically awaken when a hostile creature is within 15 feet of you. If you awaken in this way, you gain advantage on your first initiative roll within 1 minute.

At creation, you can choose to have this weapon deal force damage instead of bludgeoning damage. You can use your Charisma modifier on attack and damage rolls made with this weapon. A target hit by this weapon cannot make opportunity attacks targeting creatures other than you until the start of your next turn.

sheet.description: You can choose to have your Pact of the Blade weapon deal force damage instead of bludgeoning damage. You can use your Charisma modifier on attack and damage rolls made with this weapon. A target hit by this weapon cannot make opportunity attacks targeting creatures other than you until the start of your next turn.

p.em: Prerequisite: Serpent Empress patron, Pact of the Chain feature

description.p: When you have an imperial cobra as your familiar, it gains additional hit points equal to your warlock level. While your familiar is within 10 feet of you, it can use its reaction to make an attack whenever you take damage.

sheet.description: While your familiar is within 10 feet of you, it can use its reaction to make an attack whenever you take damage.

description.p: Whenever you cast a cantrip that deals damage or make a weapon attack, you can use your bonus action to empower it with elemental fire. The cantrip or attack deals fire damage instead of its normal damage type. When you do so, enemies within 5 feet of you take necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier as black ash bursts from your body.

sheet.description: Whenever you cast a cantrip that deals damage or make a weapon attack. The cantrip or attack deals fire damage instead of its normal damage type. When you do so, enemies within 5 feet of you take {{charisma:modifier}} necrotic damage.

description.p: As an action, you can touch one unattended nonmagical object that weighs less than 30 pounds, such as a shield, gemstone, or glaive. The object disappears into a hidden pocket dimension. As an action on a subsequent turn, you can access this pocket dimension to retrieve the item. You can have only one item stored at a time, and an item that is under the effects of a magical spell or effect cannot be stored. If you die or are reduced to 0 hit points, the item exits the pocket dimension and falls to the ground in your space.

sheet.description: You can touch one unattended nonmagical object that weighs less than 30 pounds, such as a shield, gemstone, or glaive. The object disappears into a hidden pocket dimension. As an action on a subsequent turn, you can access this pocket dimension to retrieve the item. You can have only one item stored at a time, and an item that is under the effects of a magical spell or effect cannot be stored. p.em: Prerequisite: Ashen Wolf patron, Pact of the Blade

description.p: You can summon a coating of embers and ash to cover your skin, protecting you from harm. You can choose to have your AC equal 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Charisma modifier. If a creatures hits you with a melee attack while this armor is active, you can use your reaction to deal fire damage to the creature equal to your Charisma modifier.

sheet.description: You can choose to have your AC equal {{ac:hide of cinders}}. If a creatures hits you with a melee attack while this armor is active, deal {{charisma:modifier}} fire damage to the creature.

description.p: On your turn, when you score a critical hit with an attack roll or reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you can cast any cantrip that targets an enemy creature as a bonus action. Once you use this invocation, you can’t do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

sheet.description: On your turn, when you score a critical hit with an attack roll or reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you can cast any cantrip that targets an enemy creature.

description.p: Your form is no longer bound by the laws of reality. As an action, you can choose to appear as any creature or object that is Small or Medium, such as a dog, a mass of floating lights, an idealized version of yourself, or a simple wooden crate. No matter what appearance you choose, your statistics and capacity for action are the same. This appearance is a physical change, but magic that allows others to discern the true form of shapeshifters will reveal your normal appearance. This appearance lasts until you choose to change it again.

sheet.description: You can choose to appear as any creature or object that is Small or Medium. No matter what appearance you choose, your statistics and capacity for action are the same. This appearance is a physical change, but magic that allows others to discern the true form of shapeshifters will reveal your normal appearance. This appearance lasts until you choose to change it again.

p.em: Prerequisite: Eternal Citadel patron, Pact of the Blade

description.p: You gain proficiency in shields. While you are wielding your pact weapon, you are considered to have a shield equipped.

sheet.description: While you are wielding your pact weapon, you are considered to have a shield equipped.

p.em: Prerequisite: Gelatinous Convocation patron, Pact of the Blade, 11th level

description.p: When you would take damage, you can use your reaction to gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks until the end of the current turn.

sheet.description: When you would take damage, gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks until the end of the current turn.

p.em: Prerequisite: Weaver of Lies patron, level 7

description.p: You can cast the web spell once without expending a spell slot. Once you do so, you cannot do so again until you finish a short or long rest. Whenever you cast web and maintain concentration for the full duration, you can choose to have the web become permanent and impossible to dispel.

sheet.description: You can cast the web spell once without expending a spell slot. Whenever you cast web and maintain concentration for the full duration, you can choose to have the web become permanent and impossible to dispel.

p.em: Prerequisite: Forbidden Graveyard patron, Pact of the Tome feature

description.p: Whenever a creature that you can see within 120 feet of you dies or you touch a corpse, you can choose to have their name be magically inscribed in your Book of Shadows. That creature’s corpse is always considered to be present and whole within your Book. If your Book of Shadows is destroyed, all the names within are lost.

sheet.description: Whenever a creature that you can see within 120 feet of you dies or you touch a corpse, you can choose to have their name be magically inscribed in your Book of Shadows. That creature’s corpse is always considered to be present and whole within your Book. If your Book of Shadows is destroyed, all the names within are lost.

p.em: Prerequisite: Pact of the Blade feature

description.p: While you have this invocation, you gain the ability to modify your pact weapon with greater ease. If your pact weapon is an attuned magic weapon, rather than one you’ve created, you can shift its form to any weapon you could normally create using your Pact of the Blade feature when you summon it. Additionally, you can apply the benefits of any invocation that requires you to create your pact weapon, such as Butcher’s Quill or Scorched Blade, as long as it is in the appropriate form to meet that invocation’s requirements.

sheet.description: If your pact weapon is an attuned magic weapon, rather than one you’ve created, you can shift its form to any weapon you could normally create using your Pact of the Blade feature when you summon it. Additionally, you can apply the benefits of any invocation that requires you to create your pact weapon, as long as it is in the appropriate form to meet that invocation’s requirements.

p.em: Prerequisite: The Gray Portrait patron, Pact of the Chain feature

description.p: When you have an Animate Image as your familiar, it gains additional hit points equal to your warlock level. You can use your action to change the size of your animate image to any size category of your choosing.

sheet.description: When you have an Animate Image as your familiar, you can change the size of your animate image to any size category of your choosing.

p.em: Prerequisite: The Gray Portrait patron, Level 18

description.p: You can cast mirage arcane and symbol without expending a spell slot. You can cast one of these spells once. After you do so, you can’t do so again until you finish a long rest.

sheet.description: You can cast mirage arcane and symbol without expending a spell slot.

description.p: When you aren’t wearing armor or a shield, you can choose to have your AC equal 10 + your Charisma modifier + your Dexterity modifier. While you do so, your hair serpents can deliver melee spell attacks with a reach of 10 feet. If the melee spell attack hits, the serpents will bite the target, dealing poison damage equal to your Charisma modifier.

sheet.description: When you aren’t wearing armor or a shield, you can choose to have your AC equal {{ac:majestic scales}}. While you do so, your hair serpents can deliver melee spell attacks with a reach of 10 feet. If the melee spell attack hits, the serpents will bite the target, dealing {{charisma:modifier}} poison damage.

p.em: Prerequisite: Keeper of the Depths patron, Pact of the Blade

description.p: You can create a net made of coiled seaweed and living flesh using your Pact of the Blade feature, in addition to your normal Pact of the Blade weapon. It has a range of 15/30, AC 15, and hit points equal to 5 + your warlock level. The Strength DC to break free is equal to your warlock spell save DC. Creatures entangled in this net suffer 1d8 lightning damage whenever they knowingly lie.

sheet.description: You can create a net using your Pact of the Blade feature. In addition to your normal Pact of the Blade weapon. It has a range of 15/30, AC 15, and {{truth harvester net:hp}} hit points. The Strength DC to break free is {{spellcasting:dc:cha}}. Creatures entangled in this net suffer 1d8 lightning damage whenever they knowingly lie.

description.p: Whenever you deal damage with a cantrip or weapon attack, you can use your bonus action to attempt to overwhelm one target with a deadly poison. The next time the target takes bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage before the start of your next turn, they must they must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your warlock spell save DC or become poisoned until the end of your next turn. While they are poisoned, they are also blinded.

sheet.description: Whenever you deal damage with a cantrip or weapon attack, you can attempt to overwhelm one target with a deadly poison. While they are poisoned, they are also blinded.

description.p: Whenever you make a weapon attack or cast a cantrip that deals damage, you can use your bonus action to spend an amount of Gilt equal to or less than your warlock level to overwhelm the mind of your target with the truth of the Conspiracy. The target must make a Charisma saving throw against your warlock spell save DC. If they fail, they take psychic damage equal to half the amount of Gilt spent and can’t take reactions until the start of your next turn.

sheet.description: Whenever you make a weapon attack or cast a cantrip that deals damage, you can spend {{level:warlock}} Gilt to overwhelm the mind of your target with the truth of the Conspiracy. The target must make a Charisma saving throw (DC {{spellcasting:dc:cha}}). If they fail, they take psychic damage equal to half the amount of Gilt spent and can’t take reactions until the start of your next turn.

p.em: Prerequisite: Serpent Empress patron, Pact of the Blade

description.p: You can create a golden weapon from the fang of a giant serpent that deals piercing or slashing damage using your Pact of the Blade feature. You can choose to have this weapon deal poison damage. When you hit a target with this weapon, you can use your bonus action to take the Disengage action. Once do you so, you can’t do so again until you inflict the poisoned condition on an enemy or you finish a short or long rest. Critical hits with this weapon poison the target until the end of your next turn.

sheet.description: You can choose to have your Pact of the Blade weapon deal poison damage. When you hit a target with this weapon, you can take the Disengage action. Once do you so, you can’t do so again until you inflict the poisoned condition on an enemy or you finish a short or long rest. Critical hits with this weapon poison the target until the end of your next turn.

p.em: Prerequisite: The Gray Portrait patron, Pact of the Blade

description.p: You can create a finesse weapon of pale parchment covered in bloody scratches using your Pact of the Blade feature. While you are wielding this weapon, you can cast minor illusion as a bonus action. When you cast this illusion in a creature’s space, the creature takes 1d4 magical slashing damage. You learn this cantrip if you do not already know it.

sheet.description: When you create a melee weapon with the finesse property using your Pact of the Blade feature and are wielding it, you can cast minor illusion. When you cast this illusion in a creature’s space, the creature takes 1d4 magical slashing damage.

description.p: You can correctly judge the value of any object, compared to any currency, and can tell the price that any person would be willing and able to pay for an object in your possession simply by looking at the person or thinking about a person you know well. You are also aware of the current net worth and liquid assets of any person you have met and greeted formally.

sheet.description: You can correctly judge the value of any object, compared to any currency, and can tell the price that any person would be willing and able to pay for an object in your possession simply by looking at the person or thinking about a person you know well. You are also aware of the current net worth and liquid assets of any person you have met and greeted formally.

p.em: Prerequisite: Eternal Citadel patron, Pact of the Tome feature

description.p: You are instantly aware of any attempt by the other parties to break the terms of any contract or written agreement signed by you. If the contract is broken, you become aware of it.

sheet.description: You are instantly aware of any attempt by the other parties to break the terms of any contract or written agreement signed by you. If the contract is broken, you become aware of it.

p.em: Prerequisite: 6th level, Pact of the Chain feature

description.p: As an action, you can cause your familiar to sacrifice itself in an explosion of eldritch power. Choose any damage type that the familiar can inflict with an attack. Creatures within 20 feet of your familiar must make a Dexterity saving throw against your warlock spell save DC. If they fail, they take 1d6 damage of the chosen type per two warlock levels you possess or half as much if they succeed.

sheet.description: You can cause your familiar to sacrifice itself in an explosion of eldritch power. Choose any damage type that the familiar can inflict with an attack. Creatures within 20 feet of your familiar must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC {{warlock:spellcasting:dc}}). If they fail, they take {{level:warlock:half}}d6 damage of the chosen type or half as much if they succeed.

p.em: Prerequisite: Ashen Wolf patron, Pact of the Blade

description.p: You can create a wickedly barbed one-handed or versatile melee weapon made from embers and molten steel using your Pact of the Blade feature. You can choose to have this weapon deal fire damage. You can use your Charisma modifier for attack and damage rolls made with this weapon. Whenever a creature within your reach takes damage directly due to hitting you with an attack, such as from the effect of the fire shield spell, you can use your reaction to make an opportunity attack against your attacker using this weapon. If the spell or feature that would deal damage to the attacker requires a reaction, such as the Hide of Cinders invocation, you can make the opportunity attack as part of the same reaction. Once you do so, you can’t do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

sheet.description: When you create a melee weapon with the one-handed or versatile property using your Pact of the Blade feature, you can choose to have it deal fire damage. You can use your Charisma modifier for attack and damage rolls made with this weapon. Whenever a creature within your reach takes damage directly due to hitting you with an attack, such as from the effect of the fire shield spell, you can use your reaction to make an opportunity attack against your attacker using this weapon. If the spell or feature that would deal damage to the attacker requires a reaction, such as the Hide of Cinders invocation, you can make the opportunity attack as part of the same reaction.

sheet.description: While you have a record-hunter as your familiar, it gains {{level:warlock}} additional maximum hit points. Additionally, you gain the ability to cast the mending cantrip.

p.em: Prerequisite: Warrior Saint patron, Pact of the Tome feature

description.p: You can cast zone of truth once without expending a spell slot. This use recovers whenever you finish a short or long rest. You automatically succeed on saving throws against this spell.

sheet.description: You can cast zone of truth once without expending a spell slot. You automatically succeed on saving throws against this spell.

p.em: Prerequisite: Serpent Empress patron, Pact of the Tome

sheet.description: Whenever you can see a creature charmed by you, you can cause it to speak any phrase you wish. The creature thinks that it chose to say those words of its own volition, though they may not believe them to be true.
